# Singapore Property & Finance - Daily Brief (property + finance)
_Auto-generated 23 Jul 2026 (SGT). Source-linked. General information only; exact figures and eligibility are confirmed case by case._

## New Launch Update

- **Lentor Gardens Residences sells 270 units at 54% take-up on launch weekend** - The 499-unit development sold 270 units on its 18–19 July 2026 launch weekend at an average of S$2,350 psf, with three-bedroom compact units fully sold out. No new Lentor Hills launch is expected until 2027. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/lentor-gardens-residences-sells-270-units-at-an-average-of-s2350-psf/)

- **Dunearn House launches as first private residential project in Turf City precinct** - Indicative prices start from S$2,799 psf, with units ranging from S$1.475 million for a 2-bedroom to S$3.588 million for a 4-bedroom. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/price-analysis-evaluating-dunearn-house-within-the-wider-bukit-timah-and-ccr/)

## Land & En Bloc

- **Bayshore Drive GLS site awarded to Frasers-led consortium at S$1,323 psf ppr** - URA has officially awarded the mixed-use Bayshore Drive Government Land Sale tender, which drew three bids when it closed on 15 July 2026, to Gemini Residential Pte. Ltd. and Gemini Trustee Pte. Ltd. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/bayshore-drive-gls-1280-homes-integrated-mrt/)

- **Tan Boon Liat Building sold for S$950 million in what may be Singapore's biggest en-bloc deal of 2026** - Kingsford Havelock Pte Ltd has acquired the freehold Outram Road site, which carries a raised Gross Plot Ratio of 4.9 and could accommodate twin towers of up to 48 storeys. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapores-tan-boon-liat-building-sold-for-950m/)

## Rental Market & Policy

- **Condo and HDB rental market rebounds in June after May lull** - Both condo and HDB rents edged higher in June 2026 and leasing activity picked up across the board, according to the 99-SRX Rental Flash Report. [Source](https://www.99.co/singapore/insider/condo-hdb-rental-market-rebound-june-2026/)

- **Singapore lowers qualifying age for senior-friendly public housing** - The policy change could encourage older residents to right-size, potentially freeing up larger HDB flats for the broader market. [Source](https://stackedhomes.com/singapore-just-lowered-the-age-for-senior-friendly-public-housing-a-move-that-could-free-up-larger-hdb-flats/)
